full_prompt_en: A square fantasy landscape painting looks over a broad twilight plain beneath a towering luminous cloud, with an ancient tree anchoring the left foreground. The sky fills most of the frame in densely stippled indigo, violet, and blue, crossed by horizontal rose and mauve cloud bands. At the right of center, a huge cream-pink cloud rises in rounded tiers, its edges traced by many tiny warm strokes so it appears lit from within. The low horizon glows orange-gold where the distant plain begins. At the left, a thick gnarled trunk grows out of a dark grassy mound; purple-brown branches spread across the upper edge, carrying irregular deep green canopies. The tree's bark is described by tightly repeated curved lines and violet shadows, and a few pale ledges or shelf-like forms protrude from its lower trunk. Across the lower foreground, hummocks of long ochre grass curve around a dark winding hollow that leads toward the center. A small isolated tree stands in the middle distance, and tiny dark upright marks are scattered far across the sunlit plain. The ground is not smooth: almost every area is woven from short repeated strokes, stipples, and thin contour-like lines. Warm peach and gold accents run through the grass and horizon, while deep blue-violet fills the sky and the shaded tree. Light appears to radiate from the brilliant cloud and low horizon, outlining some grass tips and tree edges while the foreground remains in patterned dusk. There is no readable text. The overall composition balances the heavy dark tree at left with the immense pale cloud at right, creating a richly textured, tranquil vision of light over open land.
full_prompt_zh: 这幅方形幻想风景绘画越过宽阔暮色平原，望见一团高耸发亮的云，一棵古树固定左前景。天空占据大部分画幅，由密集点状靛蓝、紫和蓝色构成，其间横过玫瑰与灰紫色云带。中央偏右，一团巨大的奶油粉色云以圆润层次升起，边缘由许多细小暖色笔痕描出，仿佛从内部受光。低地平线在远处平原起始处透出橘金色。左侧，粗壮扭曲树干从深色草丘长出；紫棕枝条伸过上边缘，托着不规则深绿树冠。树皮由紧密重复弯线和紫色阴影描述，几处浅色台阶状形体从下部树干突出。下方前景，长赭色草丘围着一道深暗弯曲凹地，向中央延伸。中远处立着一棵孤树，更远受光平原上散落极小的深色竖痕。地面并不平滑：几乎每片区域都由重复短笔、点痕和细轮廓线织成。暖桃与金色强调穿过草地和地平线，深蓝紫填满天空和树的阴影。光似乎从亮云和低地平线发出，勾亮部分草尖与树缘，前景仍处在有纹样的暮色中。画中没有可读文字。整体构图以左侧沉重暗树平衡右侧巨大浅云，形成光照开放土地的宁静而肌理丰富的景象。
style_prompt_en: This decorative fantasy painting combines dense stippling, repeated short strokes, and contour-like lines into a continuously worked surface. Deep indigo and violet fields are warmed by peach, rose, orange-gold, and muted ochre, with the largest pale area glowing against broad dark masses. Rounded tiers and horizontal bands counter twisting branching rhythms; small marks preserve fine movement inside the larger shapes. Edges are often textured rather than smooth, their bright contours made from many tiny strokes. Light seems internally luminous near one large focal mass and low along the horizon, leaving the foreground richly patterned in cool shade. The composition balances a heavy side anchor with an open radiant opposite side. Its effect is intricate, dreamlike, and gently expansive.
style_prompt_zh: 这种装饰性幻想绘画把密集点状笔痕、重复短笔和轮廓线般的线条编成连续经营的表面。深靛蓝与紫色色域由桃、玫瑰、橘金和暗赭色温暖，最大的浅色区域在宽阔暗块前发亮。圆润层次与水平带对抗扭转分枝般的节奏；小笔痕在大形状内部保留细微运动。边缘常由肌理而非光滑线条构成，亮边由许多细小笔触聚成。光在一大片焦点附近仿佛从内部发出，在低处也有亮度，使前景在冷影中保留丰富纹样。构图以一侧沉重大块平衡另一侧开放光亮。效果繁复、梦幻且轻轻向外扩张。
theme_en: A glowing cloud above a patterned twilight plain
theme_zh: 纹理化暮色平原上方的发光云团
name: Mark Henson
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
